key_insight: SANA-WM is a 2.6B-parameter open-source world model that natively generates minute-long, 720p videos with precise camera control, matching large industrial baselines in visual quality while greatly reducing compute via a Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer.
problem_solved: Generating minute-scale, high-resolution videos with temporal coherence and camera conditioning is extremely compute- and memory-intensive; prior high-quality systems are large, resource-hungry, and often closed-source—SANA-WM addresses efficiency, accessibility, and controllability.
method: Hybrid Linear Attention: combine frame-wise Gated DeltaNet (GDN) for efficient local/frame structure with selective softmax attention for global context.
Linear Diffusion Transformer: perform diffusion in a compressed latent space with linearized attention for tractable long-range temporal modeling over minutes.
Efficiency-focused pipeline: memory and compute optimizations (e.g., chunked temporal processing, multi-scale decoding) plus an explicit camera-conditioning module for precise viewpoint control.
impact: Delivers a practical, open-source path to minute-scale world modeling that lowers compute and engineering barriers—useful for simulation, robotics, virtual production, and research into long-horizon video prediction and planning.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer blockflow showing GDN (frame-wise) + softmax attention pathways and camera-conditioning input.
Timeline visualization: sequence of frames across one minute with an overlaid camera trajectory to illustrate temporal coherence and controllable viewpoint.
Efficiency comparison chart: bars comparing params, latency/FLOPs, and quality metrics (SANA-WM vs LingBot-World & HY-WorldPlay).
Qualitative grid: side-by-side sample frames (start, mid, end) demonstrating preserved visual fidelity and camera-controlled changes.
paper_title: SANA-WM: Efficient Minute-Scale World Modeling with Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer
paper_authors: Haoyi Zhu, Haozhe Liu, Yuyang Zhao, Tian Ye, Junsong Chen
